name: options-data-mcp
description: MCP server for Options Data API — gamma exposure, VRP, IV term structure, and more

server.name: options-data
server.description: Options market structure data via the Options Data API — gamma exposure, volatility richness, IV term structure, GEX regime, strike recommendations, credit spreads, and a universe screener. Supports both subscription auth (X-API-Key header) and x402 pay-per-call (no key needed).

tools.name: get_gamma
tools.description: Get gamma exposure profile for a ticker — shows dealer positioning, flip zone, and pin strikes

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, SPY

tools.name: get_vrp
tools.description: Get volatility richness premium — compares ATM IV to 30-day realized volatility

tools.name: get_term_structure
tools.description: Get IV term structure and skew across multiple DTE buckets

tools.name: get_structure
tools.description: Full structure bundle — gamma, VRP, and term structure in one call

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, TSLA, SPY

tools.name: get_regime
tools.description: Get GEX regime — stabilizing vs destabilizing, flip zone status

tools.name: get_strikes
tools.description: Get recommended strikes — wheel/covered-call picks or GEX-based support/resistance

tools.name: get_credit_spread
tools.description: Get credit spread setup — GEX-regime-gated put/call spreads with sizing

tools.name: get_screener
tools.description: Scan a universe of optionable stocks and rank by IV, fundamentals, earnings filter, and liquidity

ticker.description: Optional ticker to focus screener on specific sector
